RENTERS INSURANCE POLICY — SUMMARY DOCUMENT
Policy holder: V. Viswanath
Policy number: RN-88471-QQ
Effective dates: March 1 through February 28 (annual renewal)

COVERAGE OVERVIEW
Personal property coverage: $42,000 for belongings stolen or damaged by
covered perils including fire, smoke, lightning, vandalism, theft, and
water damage from burst pipes (NOT flood — flood requires separate
insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program).

Liability coverage: $100,000 if someone is injured in your apartment
and you are found legally responsible.

Deductible: $1,000 per claim.

HIGH-VALUE ITEMS
Jewelry, watches, and furs have a sub-limit of $2,500 per item unless
scheduled with an appraisal. Electronics including laptops, cameras,
and drones are covered up to $6,000 total.

RENTERS INSURANCE CHECKLIST FOR MOVING
When moving to a new apartment, notify the insurer within 30 days so
the policy address can be updated. Inventory all belongings with photos
and receipts. Keep an off-site or cloud copy of the home inventory.
